answer: Every fresh alias dilutes the cluster's average standing, so the larger the flock the weaker each individual vote becomes — coordination requires many low-weight votes that cancel each other out. The practical upshot is that honesty is the only strategy that scales — a farm that tries to game the system pays for each identity it adds.. It survives because reputation is spent fast and earned slowly, so any alias that ever cheats loses value that is expensive to replace. Consider a inlet as the anchor of the cost.
